name: Ondo U.S. Dollar Token
oneLiner: USDon is Ondo's regulated USD settlement token for tokenized assets on Ondo Global Markets, backed 1:1 by cash held at U.S. broker-dealers.
collateral: U.S. dollar cash or cash equivalents held in Ondo Global Markets brokerage accounts at regulated U.S. custodial broker-dealers
pegMechanism: USDon is used as the native settlement stablecoin for Ondo Global Markets; USDC can be swapped 1:1 into USDon for purchases, and tokenized-asset redemptions can settle to USDon or to USDC when swapper liquidity is available

jurisdiction.license: Ondo Global Markets SPV; Regulation S restrictions

genius.notes: USDON is described as platform cash inside Ondo Global Markets securities-tokenization flows, so payment-stablecoin treatment remains unresolved.

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act proposed rule and public releases
Public U.S. permitted-issuer, state-qualified, official-application, and foreign-exception materials
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: Ondo materials describe USDON as stablecoin cash backed 1:1 by dollars in brokerage accounts inside a securities-tokenization platform; no public GENIUS authorization or application source was located.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

mintAuthority.summary: USDon is the native settlement token for Ondo Global Markets, issued via an Ondo GM BVI SPV; minting is issuer-controlled (USDC swapped 1:1 into USDon) against cash held at regulated US broker-dealers, verified daily by Ankura Trust.

controls.label: Ondo Global Markets issuance backend
controls.evidence: Ondo GM mints/redeems USDon as the settlement stablecoin for tokenized assets, with USDC swapped 1:1 into USDon against custodied cash at regulated broker-dealers; issuance is issuer-controlled with Regulation S restrictions and no permissionless mint route.

review.evidence: USDon is issued by an Ondo Global Markets SPV as the native settlement token; mint/redeem is issuer-controlled (1:1 USDC swap) against broker-dealer-held cash, verified daily by Ankura Trust, with Regulation S restrictions. No permissionless mint path is described.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Issuer-controlled mint model confirmed from Ondo GM materials; the on-chain USDon token minter/owner admin and proxy admin were not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain USDon token minter/owner admin and proxy admin across deployed chains before raising confidence.

reserves.name: U.S. dollar cash and cash equivalents in Global Markets brokerage accounts
